title: Google Cloud Generative AI Leader
description: Foundational Google Cloud certification for business-level generative-AI leadership. Assessed by a proctored multiple-choice exam. Exam fee and delivery options are listed on the issuer page and change over time.
relevance_rationale: Exam domains emphasize generative-AI fundamentals, Google Cloud offerings, and business strategy; prompting is only one supporting theme.
validity_or_renewal: Issuer lists a multi-year validity period with renewal options; confirm current terms on the certification page.

title: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
description: Foundational AWS certification covering AI and generative-AI concepts on AWS. Requires a paid proctored exam. Prompt engineering appears as part of broader AI practitioner domains rather than as a prompt-only credential.
relevance_rationale: Certification spans AI and generative-AI practitioner knowledge; prompting is included but not the exclusive focus.
validity_or_renewal: Follow the current AWS certification validity and recertification policy on the official exam page.

title: NVIDIA-Certified Associate: Generative AI LLMs
description: NVIDIA associate certification covering generative AI and LLM application concepts, including prompt engineering among required skill areas. Assessment and fee details are published by NVIDIA and should be confirmed on the issuer page.
relevance_rationale: Official skill coverage explicitly includes iterative prompt-engineering practices for LLM applications.
validity_or_renewal: Confirm current NVIDIA certification validity and renewal terms on the issuer certification page.

title: Microsoft Applied Skills
description: Official overview of the Microsoft Applied Skills credential family. This page describes many scenario-based lab assessments and must not be counted as one individual earnable credential.
relevance_rationale: Family spans many Applied Skills scenarios; only some credentials emphasize prompting or agents.
validity_or_renewal: Applied Skills are scenario credentials; verify current verification and lifetime terms on Microsoft Learn.

title: Microsoft Applied Skills: Develop an Agent with Integrated Tools
description: Individual Applied Skills credential assessed through an interactive lab for building an agent with integrated tools. Free with a Microsoft account; this is an assessed skill credential, not a formal multi-year certification exam.
relevance_rationale: Assessment focuses on agent construction and tool integration where prompting and orchestration skills are material.
validity_or_renewal: Verify current Applied Skills verification display and any issuer updates on the credential page.
